evidence_note: Historical race-day participant GPX, spatial display only; not official organizer route, checkpoint position or timing evidence. All participant identity, original timestamps and personal metadata omitted. Elevation samples unavailable.
geometry_export_method: consecutive-deduplication; conservative 3m Douglas-Peucker; coordinates rounded to 6 decimals; cumulative Haversine distance

elevation_provenance.method: Per-coordinate sampling of local georeferenced DEM; no runner elevation measurement
elevation_provenance.model: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 Public (2021), digital surface model, nominal 30m
